name: final-evidence-and-seal
argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$audit='D:\Projects\Unone\docs\audits\spatial-scout-fixes-2026-10-23\blind\scout-sdk-blind-v2'
$records=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $audit -File -Filter '*.json' | Where-Object {$_.Name -match '^\d{3}-'} | ForEach-Object {Get-Content -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json})
$completed=@($records | Where-Object {$null -ne $_.exitCode})
$nonzero=@($completed | Where-Object {$_.exitCode -ne 0} | ForEach-Object {[ordered]@{order=$_.order;name=$_.name;exitCode=$_.exitCode}})
$replay=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $audit 'replay-run/verification.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
if(-not $replay.passed -or $replay.backendObserved -ne 'cpu'){throw 'Independent replay evidence did not pass'}
foreach($record in $completed){
 if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $record.stdoutPath) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $record.stderrPath)){throw 'Missing raw child output'}
 if($record.timedOut){throw 'Unexpected recorded timeout'}
}
$main=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $audit 'final-project/scripts/main.luau') -Raw
$first=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $audit 'first-authored-project/scripts/main.luau') -Raw
if($main -cne $first){throw 'First/final Luau differ unexpectedly'}
$files=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $audit 'final-project') -Recurse -File | ForEach-Object {$_.FullName.Substring((Join-Path $audit 'final-project').Length+1).Replace('\','/')} | Sort-Object)
$counters=[ordered]@{
 completedRecordedChildCommandsBeforeFinalSeal=$completed.Count
 finalSealingOperation=38
 nonzeroRecordedChildCommands=$nonzero
 preexecutionOrchestrationFailures=1
 timeouts=0
 firstStrictSuccessStep=26
 firstSuccessfulSubmissionStep=27
 firstDeliveredGeometryStep=28
 authoredLuauTypeFailures=0
 deliberateNegativeCases=3
 firstUseNativeRuns=2
 independentReplayNativeRuns=2
 observedBackend='cpu'
 gpuExecutionClaims=0
 sourceFallbackStep=$null
 repoSourceReads=0
 rubricReads=0
 firstAndFinalLuauIdentical=$true
 independentReplayPassed=$replay.passed
 emptyHitsShapeDeviation=$replay.emptyHitsShapeDeviation
 finalExampleFiles=$files
}
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $audit 'COUNTERS.json'),($counters | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20))
$counters | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20
